skills.name: move_to
skills.description: Move the arm end-effector to a named location or position

skills.name: move_relative
skills.description: Move the arm by a relative offset from its current position (e.g. 5cm forward)
effects: arm has moved by specified offset

skills.name: grip
skills.description: Close the gripper to grasp whatever is currently in contact with it

skills.name: release
skills.description: Open the gripper to release the currently held object

skills.name: pick
skills.description: High-level skill: move to object location then grip it

skills.name: place
skills.description: High-level skill: move to target location then release held object

skills.name: inspect
skills.description: Examine an object closely to determine its properties or condition
preconditions: object is in field of view
effects: object properties and condition are known

skills.name: push
skills.description: Push an object in a specified direction by a given distance
effects: object has moved in specified direction

skills.name: rotate
skills.description: Rotate or reorient an object by a given angle around a specified axis

skills.name: home
skills.description: Return the arm to its default rest/home position
